fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start a instance with a custom extension
fields.name: Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\brave.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\chrome.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\msedge.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\opera.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\vivaldi.exe") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--load-extension="))
